notes.title: Mega City Force: V1.09 Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]V1.09 Patch Notes[/h3]

Hello, Agents! We’ve just pushed a new update that introduces new minigames and collectibles, and addresses a wide range of important co-op and gameplay bug fixes.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added two minigames that can be unlocked by finding their corresponding collectibles, in celebration of the [b]upcoming big announcement[/b].
[*] Two new collectible tracks.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enabled Steam Remote Play Together for local co-op.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented collectible tracks from dropping.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “recent unlock” marks for both the Alien Blaster and the Spartan Laser would not appear, and therefore could not be removed.
[*] Fixed the current melee weapon not showing in the shop when using Cyborg with the extra weapon upgrade, due to the weapon limit maxing out at four.
[*] Fixed thrown blunt melee weapons missing the base melee damage from the agent who threw them.
[*] Fixed an incorrect sprite for the weapon chest in the tutorial sequence.
[*] Fixed incorrect text description for the Flak Jacket upgrade.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could still die or trigger a Second Chance upgrade (Flux Capacitor or Just A Dream) immediately after using a self-revive.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a sound effect to loop infinitely.
[*] Fixed a co-op bug where P2’s loadout could become identical to P1’s after using a Second Chance upgrade (Flux Capacitor or Just A Dream) or when checkpoints were enabled in casual mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Robot’s Defensive ability (Overclock) could break when used with the Defensive Charger upgrade.
[*] In co-op, Rookie’s Flashbang, Cyborg’s Magnetic Pulse, and Janitor's Giant Leap no longer stun your co-op partner.
[*] Fixed Automated Missiles not being treated as an automatic weapon.
[*] Fixed a very rare bug that could occur after trying out a dual-wielded weapon in the shooting range.
[/list]

notes.title: Mega City Force | Janitor & Tunnels Update
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

Following the development of the game and according to the roadmap we have shared back when we first released the game, today we’d like to present our third free expansion of [b]Mega City Force[/b], this is the Janitor & Tunnels Update, it comes with a new agent with unique abilities, a new bonus level, more music, a new random event and some QoL & Bug Fixes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/b48f33eb92725a5d3a36c95b95e4ec8b6092213d.jpg[/img]

[h2]➕ New Content[/h2][list]

[*] [b]New optional level: Tunnels[/b]
[/list]Located after finishing the Japantown Level, similarly to other bonus levels, the entry to this level will be highlighted after defeating the bosses of Japantown at any difficulty level and any mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/e69259f55c59e7d0342299d3126f87df3d57bdd2.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New unlockable agent: Janitor[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/e0168af0dce1620eb45bb192c6e7c692bfaac6a2.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]An alternative random event has been added[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/9621b421f7f75116b1fc2041a6a6f43ea7cc1f14.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b] 2 new collectable tracks[/b]
[/list]


[h2]🛟 QoL improvements[/h2][list]
[*] Parked vehicles are now immune to melee weapons, so there is no need to worry about exploding cars while performing melee attacks near them.
[*] Now, when using a Reroll in the shop the upgrades in the cart will become locked, meaning that conveniently they will not reroll but also that they cannot be removed from the shopping cart.
[*] Purchasing the Body Armor upgrade in the shop, now will not only increase the max health capacity, but also increase the current HP by 5.
[/list]

[h2]⚖️ Balance[/h2][list]
[*] Decreased Factory boss money drop from 350 >> 300.
[*] Increased Prison boss money dropped from 330 >> 350.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Minor visual fixes like missing shadows and enemy skin variants.
[*] Hitbox size of Sawbot, Nailbot and Sparkbot slightly reduced to match better their sprite.
[*] Fixed some occasional rounding errors in Accuracy and Stamina percentage values of the weapons stats.

[b]Fixed incorrect sound effects:[/b]
[/list][olist]
[*] Fixed missing hit sound on cargo containers.
[*] Fixed missing hit sound on cargo trucks
[*] Fixed bug that prevented the Enforcer snoring sound from playing on the agent selection screen.

[/olist][list]
[*] Fixed incorrect skin picture displayed during the skin unlock animation when unlocking the tough skin for the Enforcer and Engineer agents.
[*] Fixed a bug with dual wielding weapons that would cause the ammo level to go under zero and become wrongly displayed as infinite.
[*] Fixed a bug where if the Extra Holster upgrade was acquired with cyborg bringing the weapon slots count up to 4 while having a melee weapon, the HUD indicator for the Melee slot would break and display an empty gap.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the tooltip from changing size when changing the weapon currently carried against the compared weapon in the ground.
[*] Fixed a bug that incorrectly displayed the damage per second stat of Blunt Objects when being compared. This was leading to situations where 2 weapons compared against each other impossibly showed as having less damage than the other.
[*] Increased the damage bar maximum in the weapon stats, since some melee weapons were far surpassing the bar maximum when factoring in the stats and upgrades from the player inspecting the weapon.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the boss in Factory (Level 2.5) to become stuck without attacking under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused corpses not to be always charred when killed by the Incinerator Unit weapon from the Robot.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]💖 Thank you! [/b][/h2]

Thank you for supporting [b]Mega City Force[/b], and I hope that you'll have a great time while exploring all the new stuff that been added!

notes.title: Mega City Force | Factory & Robot Major Content Update #2
notes.notes:
[h1]G'day Agents![/h1]

The [b]Factory & Robot update[/b] is here after a delay, and it is packed with [b]new content[/b], [b]QoL improvements[/b] (we’ve fixed the melee system, read below to learn more!) and as usual, a bunch of bugs has been identified and fixed, so here’s the update! 🔥

[previewyoutube=yTkcvWD5XXM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🆕 What’s new?[/h2]

[h3][b]🏗️ Bonus Factory Level[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/cf4dcec59bd1c944680caa1956f53eda0da14eb8.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🤖 Robot Agent[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/00ff0336e19013de37501ed707130e28978e7c78.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⚔️ Reworked melee weapons to use a dedicated melee weapon slot[/b][/h3]

In other words, now they do not count towards the maximum you can carry but you can only carry one melee weapon at a time. Additionally, the [b]basic melee attack will now always try to use the currently carried melee weapon so the player can benefit from their better statistics[/b] without having to swap manually to them. Nonetheless, the player can still select the melee weapon normally and use it as its main combat weapon like before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/328cfb31689ebc27a6b7604a57e5fb1408a033b0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]💱 A new currency for shop re-rolls has been added[/b][/h3]
[i](This currency can be exchanged while in the shop in order to refresh the randomized shop contents)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/688a56c96c129049f4a121a4b444ab1904162db6.gif[/img]


[h3][b]❤️ QoL Improvements...[/b][/h3]

The game is shifting from hidden levels towards [b]Bonus Levels[/b]. We decided to do that to make [b]Bonus Levels[/b] more accesible for players, as we can see that a lot of people don't even know that those hidden locations exist in the first place. Additional levels are a part of the whole game experience, and we want to give an opportunity to as many players as possible to be able to access these parts of the game, and enjoy fighting [b]new bosses and unlock more agents[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/cbfc140f39f6224e2e4c4a60d9670e02c904ca71.gif[/img]

So now the entrances to [b]Bonus Levels are clearly indicated[/b] with the camera focusing on their entry. Now these levels will spawn multiple medkits on their entrance area; in addition, a re-roll die will be granted when defeating the boss on these levels.

[h3][b]🌆 And minor changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new random event
[*] Added 2 new collectible tracks.
[*] Added a new animation sequence to the game ending to clearly show when a new skin has been unlocked.
[*] Added an extra line for melee weapons, describing the effect they cause.
[olist]
[*] “Stun 1s” for Blunt Objects.
[*] “Bleed 4s” for Sharp Objects.[/olist][/list]
[b][h1]❗ But that's not all![/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/b7e020b8a74f6446880d3dd71becae22fb931d8f.png[/img]
[h3]🚨 Holiday siren is activated![/h3] 
The citywide [b]Steam Winter Sale[/b] will begin shortly, and we have opted in! Expect new decorations in the HQ and a whopping [b]20% discount on Steam[/b] starting at [b]21st December, 10:00AM PDT![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/d0f9fcfc2e4b8c70f73d7bf448ce8ee57b58441f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⚒️ And, of course, Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]The tracking of the bullseye combo was inconsistent and confusing for weapons that shoot more than one projectile at a time. The combo was reset or increased based on the outcome of the first impact of the projectiles of the attack. To fix these, 2 actions have been taken:
[olist]

[*] Now the successive projectiles of a burst are tracked individually (same as non burst projectiles) and each one will increase or reset the bullseye combo accordingly at the time of its impact.
[*] Now the simultaneous projectiles of a “multi shot” (like shotgun pellets) will increase the bullseye combo when any of them hits an enemy and reset the combo only when all of them have impacted and missed.
[/olist]

[*] Fixed an issue that tracked incorrectly the accuracy for the marksman contract with continuous attacks (Plasma guns and Electro-guns) making them track more hits than intended, even causing the percentage to go above 100%.

[*] Fixed an issue that considerably limited the fire rate of dedicated melee weapons.

[*] Firing will not be interrupted by any other inputs now; so Electro-guns, Particle beams and automatic weapons with charge time will not “restart” when the ability button is pressed, for example.

[*] Fixed a weird interaction with elements that drop to the ground and the parking lines in the MegaCorp level that caused these elements to move out of the parking lines, this was specially affecting gameplay when using weapons that shoot projectiles that drop to the ground like grenades.

[*] Fixed small misalignment of the Modern Machine Gun silhouette placement in the HUD.

[*] The damage (Max DPS) shown in the information/tooltip for weapons with attacks that cause effects like radiation, burn or bleed was displaying a higher value than the maximum damage per second they can actually output.

[*] Fixed a situation where the Captain sprite could stay white.

[*] Fixed a rare bug where some weapons (mostly laser weapons) will jam if dying under a very specific timing and then reviving with the self-revive. Swapping weapons fixed it, but one of these weapons specifically (Binary Laser) also blocked weapon swapping, invalidating the workaround.

[*] Fixed a visual bug that displayed a 6hp text popping up when it is actually 7hp if you pick a health pack while having the medical nanites upgrade.
[/list]

[h2][b]💖 Thank you! [/b][/h2]
Work on this update was quite hard, but nonetheless I am happy the way that it turned out. It is not the last update, so after a short coffee break, I will start working on the next update according to the roadmap. Again, thank you for supporting Mega City Force, and I hope that you'll have a great time while exploring all the new stuff that been added!

notes.title: Mega City Police: V1.04 Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]V1.04 Patch notes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/ed1d904bb5100094c35a1bcdc1f063f558d4fff8.jpg[/img]

Hello Agents! We just pushed a new update addressing some issues in controller support, added crosshair modifications and more! Here are the full changes!

[h2]🆕 QoL improvements[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Added additional colors to the starting weapon rarity text (and its star symbol) in order to set them apart based on their quality (For example, unlocked starting weapons are usually better than the default starting weapon).
[*] Show the rarity of weapons seen in the shop in the bottom right corner of their button itself for an easy overview.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/ab18b9653f2180007c4ad6923930b0e9d6c908f0.png[/img]

[*] Interface options gathered under a new options submenu.
[/olist]
[h2]🛠️ Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Corrected the bullseye contract text to properly reflect that the reward is $2 now.
[*] Fixed a regression issue that caused the timer for Speedster and Overachiever contracts to stop working.
[*] Fixed the incorrect count of unlocked skins for the Fashionista achievement.
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation for the Mercenary and the Outlaw agent info.
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation with D-pad not working in the shop.
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation on the initial streamer mode selection.
[*] Fixed the radio playlist from having an incorrect amount of tracks per page listed.
[*] Fixed a situation that sometimes made pickups become stuck inside the top walls, making it unreachable for the player.
[*] Fixed some weapons that were not giving you their ammo by simply walking over them.
[*] Fixed a bug that broke the game menu when pressing ESC during the difficulty unlock animation.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the game to occasionally stay stuck on the loading screen while playing in casual mode.
[*] Fixed the Engineer Drone behaving erratically when the player gets killed in the middle of using it while still having a Self-revive upgrade.
[*] Fixed a bug that potentially left enemies stuck with the bus prop recently added to the ruins level.
[/olist]
[h2]⚖️ Balance[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Increased the aggression of a few bosses.
[*] Reduced the aim speed of Visor’s laser (First boss) since now he is more aggressive and will chase you closer to stop you from staying put behind wall corners.
[*] Friendly fire damage from explosive weapons has been reduced to half.
[/olist]
[h2]❤️ Accessibility Features[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added crosshair customization under interface options.
[/olist]

notes.title: Mega City Police | The Prison, Major Update 🚓
notes.notes:
G'day Agents!

The Prison update is here, and it is packed with new content, QoL improvements, a bunch of bugs are also fixed thanks to your reports on Steam Discussions and our Discord ❤️, so without any long introductions, here’s the update! 🔥 

[previewyoutube=Q5bqHx6z-bU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]🔥 New Prison Level and Agent 🔥[/b][/h3]
Uncover the new level, offering fresh challenges that'll put your skills and brains to the test. Plus, gear up with a new agent, THE OUTLAW, armed with unique abilities that we won’t spoil for you 👀.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/dc7942d3e057a53f21295383bdfa4d691fa50bba.png[/img]

[h3][b]🎵 Musical Collectibles 🎵[/b] [/h3]
Get in the groove with 2 new collectible tracks that'll add an extra beat to your crime-fighting adventures.

[h3][b]🖼️ Visual Upgrades 🖼️[/b][/h3]
Darkened scorched cars with highlighted blast marks for improved contrast, making them stand out in the chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/f12d170733c8450686dce4ddf43a039b7d27d08b.png[/img]


[h3][b]🔢 Clearer weapon rarity 🔢[/b][/h3]
Now with Roman numerals instead of letter, starting weapons are marked with a star emoji!

[h3][b]✨ Shop Enhancements ✨[/b] [/h3]
We've polished your experience. See your equipped weapons during shopping sequences for quicker decisions, and easily spot ammo compatibility for each weapon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/c21cc1525e34c9667277a16d08ac1dc71d2b92a1.png[/img]

[h3][b]🐜 Bug Squashing 🐜[/b] [/h3]
We've stamped out various bugs, including issues with agent skins, contracts, and more. Your experience will be smoother than ever.

[h3][b]🔄 Balancing Tweaks 🔄[/b] [/h3]
Dive into enhanced gameplay with more ammo crates for boss battles, improved difficulty balance, adjusted contract rewards, and even more weapon power.

Now, without further ado, here are the detailed patch notes for the v1.03 update:

[h2][b]🔧 Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*] Multiple bug fixes related to activating abilities.
[*] Corrected ready icon for Enforcer attack ability.
[*] Fixed issues with enemy spawning and placement.
[*] Improved UI responsiveness and stability.
[*] Resolved agent skin selection and display bugs.
[*] Addressed various localization text issues.
[/list]

[h2][b]⚖️ Balancing and Gameplay[/b][/h2][list]
[*] Introduced a new hidden level and agent with unique abilities.
[*] Fixed a bug that happened when pressing ESC right after taking the car to start a run.
[*] Added 2 new collectible music tracks for an immersive experience.
[*] Improved visual clarity with enhanced contrast on scorched cars.
[*] Shopping experience refined, displaying equipped weapons and ammo types.
[*] Weapons now show their ammo type compatibility within brackets.
[*] Streamlined comparison button functionality during shopping.
[*] Various balancing adjustments for better gameplay dynamics.
[*] Particle guns have lingering radiation effects on enemies.
[*] More ammo crates added for final boss battle.
[/list]

And that’s all for today, stay tuned for the next update of The Factory & Robot agent 😉 and as usual, thank you all for your continuous support, and we hope you have a fantastic week 🙌

notes.title: Mega City Police: V1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! 

I hope this message finds you in high spirits, because I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to each one of you who joined us in our thrilling journey through the mean streets of Mega City Police. 🎮

Thanks to your support and enthusiasm, we had an incredible launch last week, and I’m super pumped to share that we've already received a whopping 100 reviews on Steam! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/ef2da39becf2e89d15996605635ee820243c811e.jpg[/img]

Your feedback, discussions on Steam, and active participation in our Discord server have been extremely helpful to us. We took notes, and today, I’m excited to announce our first update: V1.01 Patch Notes! 📜

This update is packed with fixes, tweaks, and accessibility features that enhance your experience in Mega City. We've also addressed multiple bugs related to ability activation, ensuring smoother gameplay and tactical precision. Enforcer's attack ability, proximity mines, and controller navigation have all received the attention they deserved. 

🛠️ Additionally, we've added accessibility settings to make your adventure more customizable and comfortable than ever before! 🎮👀

[h2]📜 Patch Notes:[/h2]

[u][b][h3]Fixes:
[/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Addressed multiple bugs related to activating abilities when leaving the level.
[*] Corrected the Enforcer's attack ability's ready icon.
[*] Fixed a situation allowing the Enforcer to shoot around the police station.
[*] Resolved a visual bug affecting the Enforcer shield during level changes.
[*] Ensured proper behavior of the “ability ready” HUD when changing levels.
[*] Proximity mines now trigger correctly when placed near stationary enemies.
[*] Fixed a crash occurring after beating the game on extreme difficulty.
[*] Restored gamepad navigation for Achievements and Overview menus.
[*] Adjusted text sizes in Asian languages for better readability.
[*] Improved localization texts for a few languages.
[/list]

[u][b][h3]Accessibility Features:[/h3]
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a camera lock setting to keep the camera on top of the player.
[*] Introduced a setting to disable stereoscopic 3D menu effects.
[/list]

Your engagement has been inspiring, and we're committed to delivering the best possible experience in [b]Mega City Police[/b]. Our developer is tirelessly working on future updates and improvements, as we have shared with you all in our free expansions roadmap, so stay tuned for more!
